items.title: As London/European traders head for the exit the major indices in Europe close mostly lower
items.summary: As London and European traders head for the exits, European shares are closing mostly lower, with selling seen across most of the major markets. France’s CAC led the declines with a fall of 1.68%, while Italian, Spanish and UK shares also finished under pressure. Germany’s DAX was the lone bright spot, managing to eke out a modest gain of 0.27%.
items.summaryZh: 随着伦敦和欧洲交易商纷纷退出，欧洲股市收盘价大幅下跌，大多数主要市场都出现了抛售。法国的CAC下跌1.68% ，领跌，而意大利、西班牙和英国的股票也在压力下收盘。德国的DAX指数是唯一的亮点，小幅上涨0.27%。
